visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a brown shirt and a gold necklace, stands in front of light green curtains. She holds a black external hard drive with the ROG logo and points toward the camera while speaking with an expressive face. (2) The scene cuts as a lime green pillow is thrown from off-screen, hitting the woman's head. She reacts with a comical, exaggerated expression of surprise and laughter while still holding the hard drive. (3) The video transitions to a screen capture of a Mac 'Info' window showing file system details for a drive named 'M9pegn-500G', displaying storage capacity as 511.36 GB. (4) Graphic overlays appear on a light blue background with icons of suns and clouds. Textual comparisons between Windows and Mac systems are shown, using arrows to illustrate the conversion of bytes into KB and eventually GB. (5) The woman reappears, hugging the lime green pillow tightly to her face and laughing. She holds the ROG hard drive up again, looking directly into the lens with a playful and humorous demeanor in a brightly lit indoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你知道為什麼買硬碟容量會不見嗎？ [Subtitle]: 例：512GB -> 476GB. (2) [Subtitle]: 我知道啊. (3) [Subtitle]: 不是啦，你要說你不知道. [Variety]: 抱歉再一次. (4) [Subtitle]: 我不知道欸. (5) [Subtitle]: 問我問我. (6) [Logo]: ROG. (7) [Subtitle]: 雖然用Mac插就有511GB. (8) [Subtitle]: 拿來裝東西也沒什麼問題. (9) [Subtitle]: 那30GB去哪了？ (10) [Subtitle]: 其實30GB沒有不見. (11) [Subtitle]: 容量還是在那，只是算法不一樣. (12) [Subtitle]: Windows用的是二進位. [Subtitle]: 1KB是1024 Bytes. (13) [Subtitle]: Mac用十進位. [Subtitle]: 1KB是1000 Bytes. (14) [Subtitle]: 你買這個硬碟在Mac是這麼多Bytes. (15) [Subtitle]: 等於512GB. (16) [Subtitle]: 在Windows是這麼多Bytes. (17) [Subtitle]: 等於476GB. (18) [Subtitle]: 老實說Windows要寫GiB才對啦 (gibibyte). (19) [Subtitle]: 那你之後會改講GiB嗎？ (20) [Subtitle]: 不會啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 講GiB誰聽得懂啊.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on why the storage capacity of a hard drive appears smaller on Windows compared to Mac. It uses a comedic 'failed take' approach to grab attention before diving into a technical comparison between binary and decimal calculation methods.
